Business Dynamics Statistics (BDS)

Establishment births, deaths, and employment from Census BDS (1978-present)

get_business_dynamics()
Get Business Dynamics Data (from cori.data.bds)
get_business_dynamics_by_sector()
Get Business Dynamics Data by Sector (from cori.data.bds)
get_business_dynamics_by_age()
Get Business Dynamics Data by Establishment Age (from cori.data.bds)
get_business_dynamics_by_size()
Get Business Dynamics Data by Firm Size (from cori.data.bds)
get_employment_dynamics()
Get Employment Dynamics Data (from cori.data.bds)
get_employment_dynamics_by_sector()
Get Employment Dynamics Data by Sector (from cori.data.bds)
get_employment_dynamics_by_age()
Get Employment Dynamics Data by Establishment Age (from cori.data.bds)
get_employment_dynamics_by_size()
Get Employment Dynamics Data by Firm Size (from cori.data.bds)
get_bds_codebook()
Get BDS Variable Codebook (from cori.data.bds)
pull_bds_raw()
Pull raw BDS data using the Census API (from cori.data.bds)

FCC Broadband Data

National Broadband Map and Form 477 data

get_nbm_county()
Load NBM Broadband Servicable Location (BSL) counts for given Census County from CORI S3 bucket (from cori.data.fcc)
get_nbm_available()
Get a list of files availables in FCC servers (from cori.data.fcc)
get_nbm_release()
Get a list of release available in FCC NBM (from cori.data.fcc)
get_fcc_dictionary()
Display FCC variables and associated descriptions (from cori.data.fcc)

S3 Data Access

Low-level S3 operations for reading/writing data

connect_to_s3()
Open a DuckDB connection configured for S3 access (from cori.data.s3)
has_local_aws_credentials()
Detect locally configured AWS credentials (from cori.data.s3)
set_aws_credentials()
Install aws credentials in your .Renviron file and load credentials into the current environment. This actions will overwrite any values currently stored in AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. (from cori.data.s3)
get_s3_object()
Download an object that is hosted on S3 (from cori.data.s3)
read_s3_object()
read a text file (csv) in a s3 object in memory (from cori.data.s3)
write_s3_object()
write a data.frame into a csv in a s3 bucket (from cori.data.s3)
list_s3_objects()
List every "keys" from a bucket (from cori.data.s3)
sync_s3_to_local()
Sync S3 objects to a local directory (from cori.data.s3)
